item.title: US reportedly evacuates aircraft from RAF Mildenhall over Iran threat
item.body: The US military has reportedly evacuated aircraft from a second British airbase over a threat from Iran. Two refuelling tankers diverted to Germany on Monday morning, weeks after the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford over a suspected Iran-linked security incident.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🛡️ US reportedly evacuates aircraft from RAF Mildenhall over Iran threat

The US military has reportedly evacuated aircraft from a second British airbase over a threat from Iran. Two refuelling tankers diverted to Germany on Monday morning, weeks after the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford over a suspected Iran-linked security incident.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 10 November, 09:50
